title: Alex1177's Mods
description: This is a Modpack Primarily Containing Mods I Own.
body:
## Alex1177's Mods
This Modpack Contains **Primarily My Mods**.

Please Support Me by Checking out my Other Projects.

Mods That I Own That It Contains Include:
- Achievements++ - A Old Mod that Adds **More Achievements** (Not that much Effort Put into it)
- Admin Tools - Tools for Admins (Once again not That Much Effort)
- Connected Dimensions - Instead of Dying in the Void it Teleports you to the **Same Coordinates in the Air** of Another Dimension (Check it Out to See how They Connect)
- Custom Greetings - Adds the Small Text Greeting **each time Someone enters a World** (Only Happens 3 times then stops, and it's editable in the Config Files)
- **Life Steal Mod** - Adds **LifeSteal SMP Mechanics** with some Stuff added (A Main Mod)
- Locating Players/Entitys - Allows for Locating Players/Entitys with a ping on them to tell them that you saw their location.
- **Miners** - Adds a New Ore to Go to a **New Mining Dimension** where you could mine anything up out of the Ground (A Main Mod)
- MSC - Minecraft Server Commands, A Mod that Adds more Commands into the Game (Use ```/About-MSC``` in game to see all the Commands)
- OTFT - O is for Tick Freeze Toggle - Allows for Creative/Spectator Players to **Press 'o' to Freeze/UnFreeze the Game** (Uses /Tick Freeze/UnFreeze to Do it) also Adds a Survival Mode Item to do it But it only does it for a certain period of time.
- **P.O.A.** - Power of Air, A mod that adds a **Air Collecter that turns into a Air Bucket** over time Holding it and Can Craft into a **POA item** which can be used to temporarily gain **buffs and get 3 powers**, a dagger, Tendrils that Shoot Air, and a Launch, with some other Passives including not taking fall damage (A Main Mod)
- **Step and Get** - Like the Name says **Whatever you Step on You Get** (A Main Mod)

Along with these Mods there are Many Other Preformance and QOL Mods For Example:
- Controlling - Shows a **Search Bar** in the Key-Bindings Menu
- Crash Assistant - **Helps Debug** During a Crash
- Jade - **Information HUD** Mod
- JEI - Just Enough Items, A Mod that Allows for **Searching of Recipes** in the Inventory
- Sodium - A **Great Preformance Mod** and Reworks the Video Settings

> And There Are Many More Mods in This Modpack.
